raw_results.question: Which house has the most members? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT p) AS members
WITH collect({house: house, members: members}) AS rows, max(members) AS maxMembers
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row.house AS house, row.members AS members, maxMembers
WHERE members = maxMembers
RETURN house, members
ORDER BY house

MATCH (h:House)
OPTIONAL MATCH (h)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(p:Person)
WITH h, size(collect(DISTINCT p)) AS members
ORDER BY members DESC, h.name ASC
RETURN h.name AS house, members
LIMIT 5

raw_results.question: Which house has the most Knights? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:Knight)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT k) AS knights
ORDER BY knights DESC, house
WITH collect({house: house, knights: knights}) AS rows
WITH rows[0].knights AS maxKnights, rows
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row.house AS house, row.knights AS knights, maxKnights
WHERE knights = maxKnights
RETURN house, knights
ORDER BY house

MATCH (h:House)
OPTIONAL MATCH (h)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(k:Knight)
WITH h, size(collect(DISTINCT k)) AS knightCount
WITH max(knightCount) AS maxCount
MATCH (h2:House)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(k2:Knight)
WITH h2.name AS house, count(DISTINCT k2) AS knightCount, maxCount
WHERE knightCount = maxCount
RETURN house, knightCount
ORDER BY house

raw_results.question: Which house has the most Kings? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:King)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT k) AS kings
WITH collect({house: house, kings: kings}) AS rows, max(kings) AS maxKings
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row, maxKings WHERE row.kings = maxKings
RETURN row.house AS house, row.kings AS kings
ORDER BY house

MATCH (k:King)
OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
RETURN k.name AS king, collect(DISTINCT h.name) AS houses
ORDER BY king

raw_results.question: Which house can claim the most people as members? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h, count(DISTINCT p) AS members
WITH max(members) AS maxMembers
MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT p) AS members, maxMembers
WHERE members = maxMembers
RETURN house
ORDER BY house

MATCH (h:House)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(p:Person)
RETURN h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT p.name) AS members
ORDER BY members DESC, house
LIMIT 10

MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WHERE h.name IS NOT NULL AND h.name <> 'None'
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT p) AS members
WITH collect({house: house, members: members}) AS rows, max(members) AS maxMembers
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row WHERE row.members = maxMembers
RETURN row.house AS house, row.members AS members
ORDER BY house

raw_results.question: Which house is home to the highest count of knights? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:Knight)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT k) AS knightCount
ORDER BY knightCount DESC, house
WITH collect({house: house, knightCount: knightCount}) AS rows
WITH rows[0].knightCount AS maxCount, rows
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row WHERE row.knightCount = maxCount
RETURN row.house AS house, row.knightCount AS knightCount
ORDER BY house

MATCH (h:House)
WITH h, size([(h)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(k) WHERE k:Knight | id(k)]) AS knightCount
WITH max(knightCount) AS maxCount
MATCH (h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, size([(h)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(k) WHERE k:Knight | id(k)]) AS knightCount, maxCount
WHERE knightCount = maxCount
RETURN house, knightCount
ORDER BY house

raw_results.question: Which house has produced the greatest number of kings? Return the name of the house and nothing else. Return all the top house names if there are ties.

parameters.query:
MATCH (k:King)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT k) AS kings
WITH collect({house: house, kings: kings}) AS rows, max(kings) AS maxKings
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row.house AS house, row.kings AS kings, maxKings
WHERE kings = maxKings
RETURN house, kings
ORDER BY house
MATCH (k:King) OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House) RETURN k.name AS king, k.title AS title, collect(h.name) AS houses ORDER BY king

MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(p.title,'')) CONTAINS 'king'
RETURN h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT p) AS kings, collect(DISTINCT p.name)[0..20] AS examples
ORDER BY kings DESC, house LIMIT 20

MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WHERE toLower(coalesce(p.title,'')) CONTAINS 'king'
RETURN h.name AS house, p.name AS person, p.title AS title
ORDER BY house, person

MATCH (p:Person)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(h:House)
WHERE p.title STARTS WITH 'King '
WITH h.name AS house, count(DISTINCT p) AS kings
RETURN house, kings
ORDER BY kings DESC, house

MATCH (h:House)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(p:Person)
WITH h.name AS house, [x IN collect(DISTINCT {name:p.name, title:p.title}) WHERE x.title STARTS WITH 'King '] AS kings
WITH house, size(kings) AS kingCount, kings
ORDER BY kingCount DESC, house
RETURN house, kingCount, kings[0..20] AS kings LIMIT 10

raw_results.question: When organizing kings according to their involvement in battles, would Tommen Baratheon and Balon Greyjoy belong together? Answer Yes or No and nothing else.

parameters.query: MATCH (k:King) WHERE k.name IN ['Tommen Baratheon','Balon Greyjoy'] OPTIONAL MATCH (k)-[r:ATTACKER_KING|DEFENDER_KING]->(b:Battle) RETURN k.name AS king, labels(k) AS labels, collect({battle:b.name, role:type(r), outcome:r.outcome}) AS involvements, count(b) AS battle_count ORDER BY king

MATCH (t:King {name:'Tommen Baratheon'})-[rt:ATTACKER_KING|DEFENDER_KING]->(b:Battle)<-[rb:ATTACKER_KING|DEFENDER_KING]-(g:King {name:'Balon Greyjoy'}) RETURN count(b) AS shared_battle_count, collect({battle:b.name, tommen_role:type(rt), balon_role:type(rb)}) AS shared_battles

MATCH (k:King)-[r:ATTACKER_KING|DEFENDER_KING]->(b:Battle) WITH k, count(b) AS c, sum(CASE WHEN type(r)='ATTACKER_KING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attacker, sum(CASE WHEN type(r)='DEFENDER_KING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS defender RETURN k.name AS king, c AS total, attacker, defender ORDER BY total DESC, king
